title: CodexBenchmarkAdapter
responsibility: Invokes Codex with explicit configuration and validates completed benchmark turns.

inputs.name: CodexBenchmarkAdapter.constructor.executable
inputs.description: Executable passed as argv[0] to Codex commands. It defaults to codex when omitted.

inputs.name: CodexBenchmarkAdapter.preflight.candidate
inputs.description: Candidate settings determine whether preflight proceeds: tools must be default and effort must not be max. Preflight runs only the version check and does not validate model access.

examples.instructions: Prefer a focused implementation that satisfies the benchmark task.

inputs.name: CodexBenchmarkAdapter.run.input
inputs.description: Supplies the candidate, working directory, prompt, optional session, and abort signal for one Codex execution. The signal is passed to the process; a session selects the resume command path.

inputs.name: CodexBenchmarkAdapter.command.input
inputs.description: Supplies the candidate model and effort plus an optional session for building the argument vector. A truthy session selects resume; otherwise the vector includes the workspace-write sandbox.

outputs.name: CodexBenchmarkAdapter.preflight
outputs.description: Trimmed stdout from codex --version. It is returned only after the supported-setting check passes and the process exits with code zero.

outputs.name: CodexBenchmarkAdapter.run
outputs.description: Benchmark turn parsed from the Codex JSON event output. If the turn has a truthy reportedModel, it must equal the candidate model; this adapter does not reject a missing or empty reportedModel.

outputs.name: CodexBenchmarkAdapter.command
outputs.description: Argument vector for codex exec with JSON output, ignored user config, the candidate model and effort, approval policy never, provider openai, and stdin marker -. A truthy session inserts resume and the session after exec; otherwise workspace-write sandbox arguments are included.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws Error for unsupported preflight settings, a failed Codex process, or a truthy reported model that differs from the candidate model. Failures rejected by the awaited process or event-parsing calls also propagate.

inputs.name: CodexBenchmarkAdapter.preflight.candidate

outputs.description: Trimmed stdout from codex --version. It is returned only after the supported-setting check passes and the process exits with code zero.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws Error when tools is not default or effort is max, or when codex --version exits nonzero; process failures also reject.

outputs.name: CodexBenchmarkAdapter.run
outputs.description: Benchmark turn parsed from the Codex JSON event output. If the turn has a truthy reportedModel, it must equal the candidate model; this adapter does not reject a missing or empty reportedModel.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws Error when Codex exits nonzero or a truthy reportedModel differs from the candidate model; process and event-parsing failures also reject.

outputs.description: Argument vector for codex exec with JSON output, ignored user config, the candidate model and effort, approval policy never, provider openai, and stdin marker -.
